ApplicantVikram Singh @ Aman, has filed the present application, under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure (hereinafter referred to as the 'Cr.PC'), with a prayer to release him on bail, in case FIR No.93 of 2023, dated 09.06.2023, registered under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code (hereinafter referred to as the 'IPC'), and Sections 6 and 8 of the Protection of Children from Whether Reporters of local papers may be allowed to see the judgment?

2. According to the applicant, he is innocent person and has falsely been implicated, in the present case.

3. As per the applicant, investigation, in the of present case, is complete and the trial of the case will take sufficient long time, as such, no useful purpose would be rt served, by keeping him, in the judicial custody, for indefinite period.
4.
According to the applicant, he is having deep roots in the society and he has termed the case of the prosecution as false.
5. Applicant has also tried his luck before the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Fast Track Special Court (POCSO), Shimla, H.P., by moving Bail Application No.325/2023.

sentences.text: However, the said bail application has been dismissed, vide order, dated 2nd September, 2023.

6. Apart from this, Mr. T.K. Verma, learned counsel appearing for the applicant, has given certain undertakings, on behalf of the applicant, for which, the applicant is ready to abide by, in case,
ordered to be released, on bail, during the pendency of the trial.

7. Learned counsel for the applicant has also highlighted the delay in lodging the FIR.

In order to buttress his contentions, he has relied upon the judgments of this Court in Cr.MP(M) No.1789 of 2019, titled as Pankaj of Kumar Vs. State of H.P., Cr.MP(M) No.2463 of 2021, titled as Sunil Kumar Vs. State of H.P. and Cr.MP(M) No.404 of rt 2021, titled as Veer Bhadur @ Vishal Vs. State of H.P.

sentences.text: As per the FIR registered with Police Station Goregaon, Mumbai, it has been mentioned that the child victim has moved a complaint for registration of FIR disclosing therein that she is about 15 years of age and permanent resident of the address, as mentioned in the application.
Her father is serving in Air India.
After passing +1 examination, the child victim along with her family members has come to Himachal Pradesh.
The entire family remained in Himachal Pradesh from 8.4.2023 to 15.4.2023.
On 8.4.2023, the entire of family reached at Chandigarh at about 7.30 p.m., through Indigo flight.
On that day, they stayed at Chandigarh.
On next day, on 9.4.2023, at about 7.00 a.m., they got booked a swift dezire No.HR45D6069, through Asia Tours Holidays.

From 9.4.2023, to 11.4.2023,
they stayed at Manali and on 12.4.2023, they come to Gallu Hills Kufri and stayed at Twin Tower Hotel at National Highway No.5.
On 13.4.2023, entire family visited Shimla.
9.4. On that day, at about 7.30 p.m., they had gone to Hotel Twin Tower for stay.
When the child victim was alighting down from the vehicle, then the driver Aman @ Vikram Singh has requested the child victim to note down the mobile number written on the vehicle.
Thereafter, the child victim has noted down the said phone number.

9.5. On that night, the child victim was apprised that he will come to meet her, after reaching at Hotel, they .
had requested for meal.
After taking their dinner, at about 10.00 p.m., the child victim has called the driver on whatsapp call.
Thereafter, she had left the room on the pretext of talking to her friend.
After coming from the hotel, the driver came to her and requested her to sit in the vehicle.
She has further rt alleged that in the vehicle, she was raped.
Thereafter, the said driver left her back in the hotel.
On 14.4.2023, they had gone to Kasauli.
On that day also, she was raped by the driver.
9.7. On 15.4.2023, they came to Chandigarh from Kasauli and stayed there for two days.
On 17.4.2023, they reached at Mumbai.
On repeated inquiry by the mother of the child victim, the whole incident was disclosed to her.
Thereafter, they took her to Goregaon Police Station, where, the report was lodged.
9.8. The child victim was medicolegally examined.

Since, the incident does not fall within the territorial jurisdiction of Police Station, Goregaon, as such, FIR was lodged with Police Station, Theog.
.

sentences.text: After registration of the FIR, police machinery swung into motion and the investigation has been conducted.

During investigation, the documents pertaining to the age of the child victim, were also obtained, according of to which, her date of birth is 23.05.2007.
9.10.
The physical evidence so collected by the police rt was sent to FSL for chemical analysis.
The supplementary challan, in the case, was submitted in the Court on 30.09.2023.
The case is now fixed for 17.11.2023, for consideration on charge.
10. On all these submissions, a prayer has been made to dismiss the application.

11. Heard.
12.
The applicant has been named, as accused, in a case, registered under Section 376 IPC and Sections 6 and 8 of the POCSO Act.

13. So far as the main arguments of the learned counsel for the applicant, with regard to delay, in lodging the FIR, is concerned, this fact will be considered, by the learned trial Court, at the time of deciding the trial.

This fact is not to be considered by this Court, that too, at the .
time of deciding the bail application.
14. The legislature in its wisdom has introduced the POCSO Act, in order to protect the children from sexual offences.
of 15.

At this stage, considering the age of the child victim, which has been mentioned, in the status report, as rt 15 years, this Court is of the view that the release of the applicant will give a wrong signal to the society that after committing such a heinous crime, the applicant is still moving freely in the society.

16. So far as the case law, as relied upon, by the learned counsel for the applicant, as referred to above, are concerned, the criminal matters, especially the bail matters are to be decided, according to the peculiar facts and circumstances of each case.

As such, no benefit could be derived by the applicant from the above decisions rendered by the learned Coordinate Benches of this Court, as the learned Coordinate Benches has decided the question of bail, keeping in view the peculiar facts and circumstances of the said case.
Considering all these facts, the applicant is not able to make out a case for grant of bail, at this stage.
Consequently, the application is dismissed.
